t: This is a building in Westminster designed by Nugent Francis Cachemaille-Day. He is remembered for some of the most revolutionary twentieth-century churches in England, and he was a leading British exponent of Expressionist architecture. His church of St Nicholas in Burnage has been called a milestone in the history of church architecture in England. Beyond that, the material I have on this particular building is thin, so take a look at the design with his reputation in mind.
